# Carcavelos Forecast – November 2, 2026

**Small but clean—grab the early glass before the wind picks up.**

This morning offers your best window: 5–11am brings consistent 1.4m waves with light NNE winds and glassy conditions. The swell holds steady at 10+ second periods, giving you peeling, predictable waves. Temperatures are cool (13–16°C), but it cleans up beautifully by 9–10am as the wind drops to near-calm.

By midday, conditions deteriorate. Waves fade to 1.2m and wind swings W-WSW, roughing up the face. Afternoon looks choppy and uninspiring—skip it unless you're desperate for exercise.

**Three tips:** (1) Dawn patrol is essential; get out by 6am before the beach fills. (2) Bring a 5/4mm wetsuit—it's chilly. (3) A small thruster or fun board works better than anything too performance-oriented; the waves won't justify it.
